shared_elements: repeated elongated vertical motifs / limb-like strokes
possible small human or hand-like forms
justification: Both surfaces are covered with reductive linear, schematic forms, and each contains something resembling small human/limb figures, but that is a very generic correspondence. A shows a few large isolated human figures with raised arms, oversized hands and held rod-like objects scattered freely over the surface, whereas B is organised into strict horizontal registers of repeated pendant/leaf motifs, a zigzag band and a plaited border, an essentially ornamental scheme with no comparable figural action.
